info.name: Agile Actors Assessment | API Aggregation
info.description: ASP.NET Core (.NET 8) API aggregation demo. Set baseUrl to the running API address (read the URL in dotnet run output or launchSettings.json). Tests verify HTTP 200 and response shape; test assertions do not require nonempty provider results. Cache TTL: 60 seconds.

request.description: Retrieves selected items from all configured providers, sorted by date descending by default.

exec: pm.test("Contains items and sources arrays", function () { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.items).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(r.sources).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("Contains items and sources arrays", function () { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.items).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(r.sources).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("Only GitHub results", function () { pm.response.json().items.forEach(x => pm.expect(x.source).to.eql("GitHub")); });

request.description: AND-combined filters: query is matched against titles within fetched items.

exec: pm.test("Contains items and sources arrays", function () { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.items).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(r.sources).to.be.an("array"); });

pm.test("Only matching Python questions", function () { const r = pm.response.json(); r.items.forEach(x => { pm.expect(x.source).to.eql("StackExchange"); pm.expect(x.contentType).to.eql("Question"); pm.expect(x.title.toLowerCase()).to.include("python"); }); });

request.description: In-memory provider fetch counts, average duration and latency buckets (cache hits are excluded).

exec: pm.test("Statistics includes provider metrics", function () { const r=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.sources).to.be.an("array"); r.sources.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s).to.have.property("requestCount"); pm.expect(s).to.have.property("averageResponseTimeMs"); pm.expect(s).to.have.property("under100Ms"); pm.expect(s).to.have.property("between100And500Ms"); pm.expect(s).to.have.property("over500Ms"); }); });
